name: The Case of the Mysterious Stalker
source:
Senior year Ichigo returns to school and just after a few warm welcomes and a few odd ones a mysterious stalker appears attacking the girls on campus and Seiji is accused of being the stalker! Now Ichigo has to uncover the truth, day by day the stalker's crimes grow more violent and time it running out. Is Seiji innocent or has he crossed the line?

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=8410]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
